summary: Ohmyhome Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of Independent Director Henliyanto Ngadini effective June 12, 2026, and the appointment of Wong Tai Kok as Independent Director and Chair of Nomination Committee, effective same date. The resignation was stated as not due to any disagreement with company operations. Wong Tai Kok brings over 5 years of finance experience and will receive US$10,000 annual compensation. This is a non-routine board change with immediate effect and annual re-appointment clause. No contest or activist element noted; appointment appears cooperative. Watch for any subsequent filings indicating further governance shifts.
